ideas.pitch: A digital tracking and compliance system tailored for industrial zones like Boisar to monitor hazardous waste disposal safely.
ideas.problem_statement: Real-world industrial environmental and waste management problems in manufacturing hubs.
ideas.title: EcoNav: Industrial Waste Traceability & Compliance Platform
ideas.why_it_could_win: Targets a local, real-world issue heavily relevant to judges and regulators in Boisar, Maharashtra, emphasizing practical feasibility over abstract concepts.

ideas.pitch: A multilingual local health triage bridge using lightweight AI and low-bandwidth capabilities for remote communities near Maharashtra.
ideas.problem_statement: Accessibility challenges in local community health triage and primary care.
ideas.title: GraminMed: Offline-First Rural Health Triage Assistant
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines a working offline demo with a high-impact social cause, directly addressing local healthcare access gaps that judges care about.

ideas.pitch: An ESP32 and BLE-based offline mesh networking tool for rapid emergency coordination during communication blackouts.
ideas.problem_statement: Emergency disaster response and reliable communication during infrastructure failure.
ideas.title: Sahayak: Low-Bandwidth Emergency Mesh Network
ideas.why_it_could_win: Features genuinely hard engineering with hardware integration (ESP32/BLE) that stands out dramatically in a room full of standard web apps.

ideas.pitch: An internal knowledge graph and RAG system for local educational institutions to preserve and transfer project documentation across graduating batches.
ideas.problem_statement: Knowledge retention and project continuity challenges faced by students and academic institutions.
ideas.title: VidyaGraph: Local Academic Knowledge Transfer Engine
ideas.why_it_could_win: Solves a pain familiar directly to students and academic organizers in the room, backed by a working LangGraph/RAG implementation.

ideas.pitch: A transparent supply chain platform tracking local agricultural produce from farms to markets in Maharashtra to eliminate middleman margins.
ideas.problem_statement: Inefficiencies and fair-pricing problems in local agricultural supply chains.
ideas.title: KrishiLink: Direct Farmer-to-Consumer Supply Chain Ledger
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly tackles regional economic problems with an emphasis on practical feasibility and a polished local demo presentation.
